source: Synthetic series generated by SoilScope's own engine on a fixed two-layer loam; this is not measured field data.
provenanceNotes: Created as a regression reference for model-pattern agreement. It must not be cited as field validation. Model v5 makes the remaining solver state bounds and the root/respiration/C-N parameters configurable; their defaults reproduce v4, so the illustrative values are unchanged from v1. To use real measurements, replace this file using docs/validation/README.md.
sampling: Eight fractions of a 168-hour plant-free run, sampled at the nearest hourly step: 21, 42, 63, 84, 105, 126, 147 and 168 h. Only the top layer is gated today; add further series for deeper layers.
generatedBy: ValidationReferenceRun (lib/domain/services/validation_reference_run.dart), SoilScope 0.1.0; no plants, no weather forcing, no cultivation events.
